name: Path Feature
summary: Outcast Path Feature Ranger Your attacks from hiding score a critical hit on 19-20. Outcast Path Feature Corsair After you move 5 ft from your Corsair feature, your next attack before your next turn gains +1d6 damage. Shadow Guide Allies moved by your Path Feature may also ignore difficult terrain until your next turn.
